title: Oraga Night — 5e Edition: the Night as a Graph

phases.label: Before the Ball
phases.summary: Each player picks a hook and an agenda. All six hooks converge on the Gatehouse Court.

phases.label: I. The Receiving Line
phases.summary: The line, the gate, Corval receiving by name. Nobody is disarmed. The honor guard faces inward.

phases.label: II. The Empty Rooms
phases.summary: The ball proper and the longest Movement. Agendas breathe; the host does not appear; Corro's gift rings.

phases.label: III. The Summons
phases.summary: A glimpse on the gallery; Corval fetches chosen guests to the Audience Hall. Three gray masks arrive.

phases.label: IV. The Toast
phases.summary: Raunu appears, promises words at the Unmasking, takes two plates and leaves. The mews scream.

phases.label: V. The Hour of Spirits
phases.summary: Lamps low, the Dead Dance, quarter-bells. Every thread comes taut. Vell walks to the river gate.

phases.label: VI. The Unmasking
phases.summary: The lights die mid-sentence. The Uninvited go to work; the snakes draw in the dark; the Crossing.

phases.label: VII. The Longest Night
phases.time: After midnight to the last bell
phases.summary: Fire, rescue, and the gate held by the Bought. The last bell takes the Uninvited.

phases.label: Endings
phases.summary: The recorded history by default, and every If-History-Breaks branch.

phases.label: Aftermath
phases.summary: The inquest, the tidy trail, Vorlain's offer. No one is ever charged.

nodes.label: The Invited
nodes.summary: Sent for by name, or serving someone who was. Fits A House's Long Game, The Prelate's Question.

nodes.label: The Entourage
nodes.summary: Companion, bodyguard or witness to someone invited. Best vantage, worst position to act.

nodes.label: The Discarded Invitation
nodes.summary: A genuine invitation with someone else's name on it. The mask custom protects you until midnight.

nodes.label: Hired for the Night
nodes.summary: Festival staff: a servant's freedom of the halls, and a servant's invisibility.

nodes.label: The Patron's Errand
nodes.summary: Untraceable hands for a faction. In this edition, your patron is also a snake.

nodes.label: The Wrong Place, Deliberately
nodes.summary: Your own reason to be inside. The ball is your cover.

nodes.label: B0. The Approach and the Line
nodes.summary: The first scene: gossip hour in the queue. First check at DC 13, near-misses offered at a cost.

nodes.label: B1. The Gatehouse Court
nodes.summary: Corval receives every guest by name from memory. Borrowed invitations tested. Nobody is disarmed.

nodes.label: Omen: nine guards facing inward
nodes.summary: Forty blades expected; nine present, all facing the palace doors, not the gates. House Boranis hired no swords.

nodes.label: B2. The Crystal Court
nodes.summary: The grand hall of rose-lit crystal; dance floor, musicians, the empty high table. Nearly every scheduled event lands here.

nodes.label: B3. The Banquet Galleries
nodes.summary: Feast halls with half-private alcoves. Best room for agenda work, and where the feud boils over.

nodes.label: The host does not appear
nodes.summary: Vorlain holds court by the wine; Kovaun takes a census of souls; Callun and Corro compare margins; Maiven presses Corval.

nodes.label: Omen: Corro's gift rings
nodes.summary: The Phern magnate loses his sentences and watches doors. His gift points nowhere.

nodes.label: B5. Garden Terraces & River Gate
nodes.summary: Lantern gardens stepping down to a locked iron river gate. The escape route. Know it cold.

nodes.label: B6. The Chapel
nodes.summary: Fresh offerings in Elanna's niche. Mother Sella's room; the ball's only short rest.

nodes.label: B7. The Trophy Gallery
nodes.summary: Plunder, guards, and a grandmother's soul-crystal. Studying the wards here pays off at midnight.

nodes.label: B8. Raunu's Study
nodes.summary: No papers anywhere: a crystal relief of the eastern coast, the lattice-key slate, scorched invitation duplicates.

nodes.label: B9. The East Wing
nodes.summary: Sealed and guarded. Veier's emptied pack, two slings, and the nursery. Reached only by errand, passage, or Undercurrent C.

nodes.label: B10. Kitchens & Service Passages
nodes.summary: Anha and the skeleton staff. The passages thread everything; at midnight, the only unwarded way through.

nodes.label: B11. The Root of the House
nodes.summary: Hidden laboratory beneath the cellars: recall-lattices, the skeleton, the orrery. The Uninvited will not enter.

nodes.label: B13. The Room You Put Here
nodes.summary: Deliberately empty; the MM fills it from what the table has chased. No Fracture, no contradiction of Chapter II.

nodes.label: 1. The Circle's Reckoning
nodes.summary: Learn the Tithe of Hands before it is proclaimed. It lives in Corval's head; kindness opens him.

nodes.label: 2. The Prelate's Question
nodes.summary: Is the man who came back the man who left? Four windows to study Raunu.

nodes.label: 3. A House's Long Game
nodes.summary: Get Vorlain to say anything Draunel could call an understanding. Essin stands in the way.

nodes.label: 4. The Cousin's Errand
nodes.summary: A memorized message and a ring, into Veier's own hands. The east wing is the only way.

nodes.label: 5. The Unpaid Debt
nodes.summary: Take grandmother's soul-crystal home from the trophy gallery. Another crew is working the same room.

nodes.label: 6. The Gate at Midnight
nodes.summary: Triple rates in old coin to unlock the river gate at midnight. The payer was Vell.

nodes.label: 7. The Story of a Lifetime
nodes.summary: Witness truly and carry the testimony out alive, in a land with no books.

nodes.label: 8. The Vanished Servant
nodes.summary: Find Anha in the kitchens; decide what to do with what she half-knows.

nodes.label: Undercurrent A: The Root of the House
nodes.summary: Barred stair, tally-cords, the wall seam, the slate key. Find: the gift-source laboratory. 'Both rivers, one spring.'

nodes.label: Undercurrent B: The Household That Wasn't
nodes.summary: A returned footman, Corval's recitation, the sworn testament. Find: the staff were evacuated with love; the remainers volunteered.

nodes.label: Undercurrent C: The Third Plate
nodes.summary: The midwife, small linens, protective guards. Find: the pregnancy, and the nursery, before the announcement that never comes.

nodes.label: Undercurrent D: The Guests Who Cast No Gossip
nodes.summary: Corval's slipping mind, Corro's compass, maskless craft. Find: three impossible guests, Fracture ammunition, Raunu's 'I know.'

nodes.label: S1. The Seating Feud
nodes.summary: Two drunk branches brawl in B3. Nonlethal. End it before the bench clock fills; earn Corval's gratitude.

nodes.label: The Circle's line
nodes.summary: Callun's Hired Knives count arrivals, shadow Corval, question the summoned, lean on Anha after the toast.

nodes.label: The Church's line
nodes.summary: Kovaun's Wardens watch the dais and east doors, ask which rooms the master uses, then pick the study lock.

nodes.label: House Draunel's line
nodes.summary: Duelists bait Essin's blades to draw first, then make a public appointment on the terraces after the bells.

nodes.label: House Boranis's line
nodes.summary: Essin's Cousin's Blades ring Vorlain and quietly steer anyone working him toward the garden doors.

nodes.label: Phern: the mirrored dread
nodes.summary: Corro's Bodyguards catch his fear: hands to hilts, backs to walls, exits marked, facing the way the guards face.

nodes.label: The Thenya: one bad hour
nodes.summary: Maiven's slingers scout and time the east wing guard; after the refused audience, a rope below the wall.

nodes.label: A figure on the high gallery
nodes.summary: Raunu glimpsed once above the Crystal Court, watching like weather, gone when looked for.

nodes.label: B4. The Audience Hall — the summons
nodes.summary: Corval: 'The master will see you.' At least one PC walks the long room. Deceiving Raunu: DC 25.

nodes.label: Omen: three gray masks
nodes.summary: Gracious, antique, on no list. Corval cannot account for them, and cannot hold the question.

nodes.label: The scout
nodes.summary: A footman in ill-fitting livery counts the gallery guards on his fingers. A lead, not a fight.

nodes.label: The Toast and the two plates
nodes.summary: Raunu appears unmasked: 'At the Unmasking I will have something to say.' Fills two plates; leaves by the east doors.

nodes.label: Maiven's audience refused
nodes.summary: Still no Veier. Corval, miserable, declines. The Thenya stop drinking.

nodes.label: Dinner for two
nodes.summary: Players who reach the east wing find Raunu and Veier at ease together — the night's one warm glimpse.

nodes.label: Omen: the mews scream
nodes.summary: Every falcon screams, then all fall silent. The gardens go quiet. Corro does not laugh.

nodes.label: The snakes turn
nodes.summary: The toast turns every line: Circle fears an heir, Draunel fears succession, Essin stops smiling, Phern mark exits.

nodes.label: The Dead Dance
nodes.summary: Lamps lowered, slow strange music, quarter-bells. Stealth has Advantage. Custom compels the host back at midnight.

nodes.label: Vell at the river gate
nodes.summary: The pale factor walks the terraces once and confirms the gate — or unlocks it himself.

nodes.label: East wing guard doubled
nodes.summary: Corval quietly doubles the east wing doors. Noticed only by those watching.

nodes.label: Omen: 'You dance like my daughter would have'
nodes.summary: The Wept, as a dance partner. Sorrow ammunition for her Fracture; needs no check.

nodes.label: S2. Knives in the Dark (the staging)
nodes.summary: Tavva's crew with rope and sacking in the dark service run. A shared noise clock: if it fills, both sides lose.

nodes.label: S4. The East Wing Doors
nodes.summary: Forcing B9 or crossing the house: the honor guard detains and expels. Losing costs the evening, not the character.

nodes.label: The Unmasking
nodes.summary: Raunu leads the rite. 'House Boranis has been silent because—' He never finishes.

nodes.label: The lights die
nodes.summary: The rose drains from the walls. Three faces still masked. 'Corval. The stairs.' Wept to Raunu, Radiant to Veier, Hollow to the doors.

nodes.label: Corro moves first
nodes.summary: Three seconds before the dark, the Phern magnate is already moving. Following him saves lives.

nodes.label: The dais
nodes.summary: Raunu spends his house's wards like coin. The nine fall. Any PC beside him steers wards at DC 10.

nodes.label: Raunu crushes the twin crystal
nodes.summary: He spends his last charge sealing every door between Veier and the river, instead of saving himself.

nodes.label: The east wing hunt
nodes.summary: The Radiant hunts Veier through self-sealing corridors. Every watching witness buys her a hallway.

nodes.label: The hall doors
nodes.summary: The Hollow holds the main doors; the crowd breaks around it like water. Two hundred hostages.

nodes.label: Fighting an Uninvited
nodes.summary: Lethal and Leashed: at 0 HP it stops indulging, throws the attacker clear, returns whole. Force and spells buy time only.

nodes.label: Steering the wards
nodes.summary: Ward-literate PCs seal corridors, flood stairs, shelter guests. From the Root, palace-wide at DC 13.

nodes.label: Fracture: the Wept (sorrow)
nodes.summary: DC 18 with one tell, DC 15 with two or more. She stops for one full round — mid-kill.

nodes.label: Fracture: the Radiant (devotion)
nodes.summary: Deny the congregation or plant the doubt. It cannot be turned; guilt slows the errand and it does not break past Vell.

nodes.label: Fracture: the Hollow (despair)
nodes.summary: Sincerity, never ferocity. He opens his hands, the doors open, and he goes home early.

nodes.label: S5. The Looters
nodes.summary: Tavva's crew strips the gallery and the fallen. The night's one fully winnable fight, aimed at better natures.

nodes.label: Knives: the Circle's delivery
nodes.summary: Heat 3–4: Hired Knives walk one of the two Tithe ministers out through the smoke to Callun. Corval is on the stairs, untouched. Heat 0–2: they just get Callun out.

nodes.label: Knives: the Church's filing
nodes.summary: Heat 3–4: Wardens come down the dark-wing stair with the drawer of scorched invitations, the slate wiped behind them. Heat 0–2: they get the Prelate out.

nodes.label: Knives: Draunel's fourth iron
nodes.summary: Heat 3–4: Duelists take Vorlain by the arms in the burning gallery (B3), to hand him to the sect guard. Default: Essin's cousins fight for him and he is not taken.

nodes.label: Knives: the cousins in the fire
nodes.summary: Essin and the cousins go into the burning gallery with Vorlain. If Draunel's heat is 3–4, they stand between him and Draunel's men.

nodes.label: Knives: the Phern door
nodes.summary: Heat 3–4: Bodyguards hold a gallery-side service door off B2 for Corro alone, and the crowd crushes. Turn it: no check if Corro trusts you, else DC 15 Persuasion.

nodes.label: Toward the fire: Maiven
nodes.summary: Maiven goes toward the east wing. She dies there unless somebody competent goes with her.

nodes.label: The Crossing: the terrace
nodes.summary: Vell turns and moves the way the Uninvited move. The wrapped sword stays wrapped. The Radiant: '...You.'

nodes.label: The Crossing: the lower garden
nodes.summary: 'Take her. The gate. Don't stop.' The crossfire: DC 13 Dexterity save each beat.

nodes.label: The Crossing: the river gate
nodes.summary: The boat. If the Radiant breaks past, whatever stands at the gate is what it must go through.

nodes.label: The last bell
nodes.summary: The leash takes all three, finished or not. The Wept looks back at whoever earned it.

nodes.label: The Longest Night
nodes.summary: Fire and smoke; the PCs are the only order. Inspiration per person carried out. Vorlain, a hero.

nodes.label: Word of other attacks
nodes.summary: Fires in two sect districts; a Blackwatch courier post dark. Diversions. Somebody was paid.

nodes.label: B12. The Gatehouse Court, Held
nodes.summary: The outer gate barred from the far side; grey coats; a sergeant reading terms from a chained case.

nodes.label: S3. The Gate at Midnight
nodes.summary: The Bought hold the gate: sergeant, Blades, then the captain. Fire clock. Three endings, all wins.

nodes.label: The Second Clause
nodes.summary: 'If a woman in Thenya wool comes out the front, hold her.' Somebody wanted Veier held.

nodes.label: Fight through
nodes.summary: Drop the sergeant and half the Blades; the rest disengage. Long if fought to the last.

nodes.label: Void the contract
nodes.summary: Employer broke terms (DC 13 Persuasion to the sergeant; the captain needs no check), target already gone, or a better offer in front of the sergeants — snake coin included.

nodes.label: The sect guard arrives
nodes.summary: On the clock's last segment, sect banners at the wall; the captain withdraws. A party that held has won.

nodes.label: History as recorded
nodes.summary: Raunu dead mid-sentence; Veier gone into the river dark; the Uninvited without trace; no one ever charged.

nodes.label: Epilogue: what do you carry out?
nodes.summary: The mists are rising again. Each player names what their character carries out. 4th level.

nodes.label: ⟨They save Raunu⟩
nodes.summary: The Wept's Fracture found early plus real sacrifice at the dais. Veier and the child must still vanish.

nodes.label: ⟨The child is taken⟩
nodes.summary: Nothing held the gate. The aftermath becomes a pursuit, with Vell as a terrifyingly forthcoming patron.

nodes.label: ⟨They trap one of the Uninvited⟩
nodes.summary: Only deep Boranis ward-crystal holds one, until the last bell. It answers one question about itself.

nodes.label: ⟨They expose the truth⟩
nodes.summary: Real evidence, and nobody powerful wants it. Exposure, not power: a campaign frame.

nodes.label: ⟨A player character dies⟩
nodes.summary: A death that holds a gate is written into the night. The player finishes as Corval, Anha, Maiven, or Vorlain.

nodes.label: ⟨The Bought change sides⟩
nodes.summary: Bought out before midnight, the company holds the gate open. Forty sworn witnesses instead of two hundred frightened ones.

nodes.label: ⟨The Second Clause succeeds⟩
nodes.summary: It must not. Reach for the honour clause or the sect guard; otherwise be generous.

nodes.label: ⟨A snake gets what it came for⟩
nodes.summary: The Church files the scorched invitations, a Tithe minister leaves in Circle hands. History, unrecorded: why the story is wrong by noon.

nodes.label: ⟨The party turns one snake on another⟩
nodes.summary: Set the factions on each other; hands stay clean. Paid as ending a fight without finishing it.

nodes.label: The inquest
nodes.summary: Draunel, Church and Circle run one inquest in three coats; the notary edits testimony as it is spoken. 5th level here.

nodes.label: Vorlain's offer
nodes.summary: Chief in all but ceremony, and afraid. Find out what happened, on his coin. The only patron who wants the truth.

nodes.label: The tidy trail
nodes.summary: Oiled river gate, a boat paid thrice over, a carter's 'factor and his sick daughter' — then nothing.

nodes.label: The mask-maker
nodes.summary: Otta Vesh on the gray masks: nobody made them, and nobody in the city would know how.

nodes.label: The file closes
nodes.summary: 'Agents unknown, likely Mazaaian.' Everyone signs. You know more than the record: what do you do with it?

nodes.label: S6. The Quiet Word
nodes.summary: An invitation to take the air: Essin's cousins warn off whoever pressed Vorlain. A warning with fists.

nodes.label: S7. The Second Plate
nodes.summary: A Circle knife leans on Anha, then works the service run toward the east wing. Service-door clock.

nodes.label: S8. The Study Door
nodes.summary: Church Wardens pick the study's crystal lock for the scorched invitations and the slate — the Root's key. Lock clock.

nodes.label: S9. The Appointment
nodes.summary: Draunel's duelist and Essin's cousin on the upper terrace, steel about to come out. Circle clock.

nodes.label: S10. Over the Wall
nodes.summary: Thenya slingers with a rope below the east wing. Only if provoked; going with them is the better bet.

nodes.label: S11. The Phern Door
nodes.summary: Corro's bodyguards hold a service door for their master alone while the crowd crushes. Turn it into an exit.

nodes.label: S12. The Minister in the Smoke
nodes.summary: Circle knives walk a Tithe-carrying minister out through the smoke. The minister's choice, not the Circle's.

nodes.label: S13. The Arrest in the Fire
nodes.summary: Draunel's duelists drag Vorlain out of his own rescue; Essin's cousins fight for him. Gallery clock.

edges.label: a death that holds a gate

clocks.label: Bench clock (S1)
clocks.advances: End of each round the principals are still swinging, and whenever anyone in the brawl rolls a 1 on a d20
clocks.fills: The honor guard floods the galleries for a Movement; one agenda door closes, named aloud

clocks.label: Noise clock (S2, shared)
clocks.advances: Any 1 on a d20, by either side; the end of each round anyone attacked with a drawn blade; anything loud
clocks.fills: The honor guard arrives and both sides lose: party detained alongside the crew

clocks.label: Fire clock (S3)
clocks.advances: End of each round the gate stays shut; any 1 on a d20, or any check failed by 5 or more, near the gate
clocks.fills: The fire reaches the Crystal Court doors; every round after costs the crowd

clocks.label: Service-door clock (S7)
clocks.advances: Each round a Circle knife moves toward the east wing's service door unhindered, or gets past a party member
clocks.fills: The knife sees the midwife and the linens, and tells Callun there may be an heir

clocks.label: Lock clock (S8)
clocks.advances: Each round the Wardens work the study lock undisturbed, and on any natural 1 in the corridor
clocks.fills: The Wardens are inside; a round later the slate is wiped and the drawer taken

clocks.label: Circle clock (S9)
clocks.advances: Each round the principals face each other; by two when a Cousin's Blade is provoked into drawing
clocks.fills: Steel meets steel; one principal goes down bleeding; Draunel's second iron is done

clocks.label: Half-bell clock (S10)
clocks.fills: The rope goes up; the honor guard answers (S4) with the Thenya as offenders

clocks.label: Crush clock (S11)
clocks.advances: Each round the door is held for Corro alone
clocks.fills: People go down at the door; it jams and nobody else gets through tonight

clocks.label: Gallery clock (S13)
clocks.advances: Each round; each segment is a guest still inside B3
clocks.fills: The gallery roof comes down on whoever is still inside

clocks.label: Snake Tracker heat (per faction)
clocks.advances: A faction's line going unanswered; automatic boxes at the toast, the Radiant's blessing and the omens (Ch. IX, Table IX-2)
clocks.fills: Read at the first scream: 0-2 they get out; 3 the faction's midnight card is live; 4 it starts with steel already out

clocks.label: The leash
clocks.advances: Story-time from the first scream (about half an hour in all); late, the Uninvited grow faster, sloppier, more human
clocks.fills: The last bell of Oraga: all three leave, finished or not
